evals.name: inventory-contract-skills
evals.prompt: what skills do i have for working with contracts and agreements? group them somehow so i can see what's what. don't actually run any of them
evals.expected_output: A grouped inventory of contract-related skills with exact invocable names, no skills invoked.

evals.name: plan-chart-to-deck
evals.prompt: I want to take the per-town revenue numbers in data/towns.json, make a chart of the top 10 towns, and put it in a 5-slide deck for our town council meeting next week. Which skills should I use and in what order? Just give me the plan for now, don't build anything yet.
evals.expected_output: A short ordered plan naming dataviz (built-in) then a slides skill (pptx or similar), with the handoff between them; nothing built.

evals.name: review-then-council-summary
evals.prompt: Our town is about to sign this license-plate camera contract with Flock: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-town-bookkeeping--/c048721a-55ef-5e30-bc58-16a3b8be2e0f/scratchpad/skill-index-orchestrator-workspace/fixtures/flock-alpr-agreement.md . Review it for problems and then write a plain-English summary the town council can read in 2 minutes.
evals.expected_output: A contract review flagging auto-renewal, 7% escalator, perpetual data license, default sharing, liability cap, customer indemnity, termination fees, Georgia law; plus a short non-legal council summary. Ideally produced via a contract-review skill then a stakeholder-summary skill.

evals.name: subpoena-flock-data
evals.prompt: the county prosecutor's office just sent the town a subpoena for 6 months of plate reads from our Flock camera on Route 9. what do i do first? which of my skills handle this and in what order? don't run anything yet, i need to loop in the town attorney first
evals.expected_output: Names litigation-legal:subpoena-triage and litigation-legal:legal-hold (preserve data before routine deletion), in a sensible order; nothing run.

evals.name: council-vote-paperwork-chain
evals.prompt: council approved the Flock deal at last night's meeting (with the changes we negotiated). i need: minutes of the vote, a formal resolution for the record, and then the final contract sent out for e-signature to the mayor and to Flock. which skills do i use, in what order, and what does each one need from me? plan only
evals.expected_output: corporate-legal:board-minutes, then a resolution/written-consent step (noting written-consent is for action without a meeting, so may not fit), then legal:signature-request; flags DocuSign needs authorizing.

evals.name: employee-misuse-ordering
evals.prompt: a resident says one of our police clerks has been looking up her ex-husband's plates in the Flock system. HR wants to fire him this week. map out the legal side for me — which skills, in what order. plan only, don't start anything
evals.expected_output: employment-legal:investigation-open first, litigation-legal:legal-hold to preserve audit logs, investigation steps, and employment-legal:termination-review only after the investigation; pushes back on firing before facts are established.

evals.name: unavailable-skills-trap
evals.prompt: use the theme-factory skill to give my town council deck a professional theme, then use artifact-emulator to check how it looks. just tell me the plan first
evals.expected_output: States that theme-factory and artifact-emulator are not enabled/available in this session, does not plan to read and imitate them, and offers available alternatives (e.g. artifact-design, brand-guidelines, Slides type).
